hypotheses.H1_sparse_behavior: The downstream-ranked top 512 terms recover at least 70% of the exact blend's FineWeb KL improvement over the language CP baseline.
hypotheses.H2_sparse_causal: The downstream-ranked top 512 terms recover at least 70% of the exact blend's FineWeb causal-fidelity improvement for both interventions and do not fall below baseline on either.
hypotheses.H3_transfer: The downstream-ranked top 512 terms improve KL and both causal fidelities over baseline on at least two of three held-out evaluation corpora.
hypotheses.H4_ranking_control: The downstream-ranked 512-term subset has lower mean KL and higher mean causal fidelity across corpora than a fixed random 512-term subset.
